purpose: Port the pinned upstream add_position_offset post-processing step as an opt-in raw-only lane. The correction maps a fixed phone antenna-to-body offset through the estimated body-to-navigation attitude; no new measurement, truth, sample, MAT, or device-provided coordinate is admitted.

selection_basis.reason: The upstream GNSS and GNSS/IMU pipelines apply a phone-specific physical antenna-to-phone-center offset after optimization. The current native raw lane emits the optimized antenna position without this explicit correction. A fixed geometry correction is independently specified and safer to port than an unobservable height/reference branch or truth-trained weighting.
alternatives_not_selected: reference-height compensation: unavailable under the raw-only contract
new optimizer or robust thresholds: would be a truth-sensitive estimator change
additional carrier/ionosphere factors: already covered by separately sealed Phase 11-19 lanes

raw_only_contract.coordinate_source: in-memory native raw GNSS/nav FGO result
raw_only_contract.attitude_source: in-memory optimized native Pose3 attitude exported by the GTSAM backend

candidate_contract.backend: existing native GTSAM Pose3+velocity+bias graph; no factor or optimizer changes
candidate_contract.application_stage: after finite optimized native solution and before raw UTC key alignment/output
candidate_contract.rotation_spec: MATLAB eul2rotm uses Rx*Ry*Rz on rpy=[roll,pitch,yaw] after subtracting [0,0,pi]
candidate_contract.offset_frame: [offsetUD, offsetRL, 0] metres in the upstream local phone frame
candidate_contract.phone_matching: upstream order: mi8; sm-g988 exact; sm or samsung; pixel6pro exact; pixel7 substring; pixel4 substring; pixel5 substring; unknown phone fails closed
candidate_contract.position_semantics: ECEF antenna estimate plus rotated local offset expressed through native ENU origin, then converted back to ECEF

structural_gate.comparison: same frozen Phase 12 native recipe with only this explicit post-processing flag added; no truth is used to select offsets or attitude

post_freeze_evaluation.scope: development evidence only; Pixel7 is already-used development identity
post_freeze_evaluation.truth_policy: seal candidate and control raw artifacts and hashes first, then read the declared development ground_truth.csv once in one evaluator process to compare both frozen outputs
gates: all four official diagnostic variants non-regress

implementation_rule: Commit this freeze record before changing source. Implement only the fixed upstream offset helper, explicit opt-in wiring, diagnostics, and parity tests; do not alter Phase 19/20 artifacts, defaults, numeric estimator parameters, or any input contract after truth access.
freeze_record_sha256: excluded-from-self-hash; compute from the committed file
